source_findings.finding: source_proof first validates loaded effective methods, PARTS, core entry points and code identities; it then calls _source_inventory and deep-copies its proof.

_source_inventory hashes source, rebuilds control-flow parts, parses effective and inherited methods for action consumption, walks constructors/event schedulers, and parses the capture module. Several method ASTs are reconstructed more than once in each call.

build_parts also checks source, splits and inverse-reconstructs decide/activate/run, and compiles fresh helper code. The generated temporary parts serve proof reconstruction here; the active model still uses pinned PARTS.
_cut depends on this exact live continuation, supplied information, deadlines, current tray, action history and heap. It is a dynamic obligation, not a reusable static proof.
Both fork and resume call source_proof and _cut; the whole graph clone, action-field restriction and post-clone validation remain mandatory.

next_diagnostic_only.call: Unchanged future.source_proof(), serially, with default GC and no monkeypatch/cache.
next_diagnostic_only.count_basis: One provider source proof plus 32 fork and 32 resume proofs for the declared successful full32 path. This is a controlled source-audit workload, not a claim that complete driver startup/export/audit has only65 proof calls.
procedure: Freeze source/import closure and interpreter plus accepted output/reference identities before starting.
Load the saved proof as a comparison target only. Run exactly65 original source_proof calls under one cProfile session; retain per-call ordinal/status and complete proof-byte equivalence.

Write raw pstats and compact self/cumulative/call-count records for source_proof/_source_inventory/build_parts/tree_of/inspect.getsource/ast.parse/ast.walk/compile/deepcopy/source-file hashing. Do not add overlapping cumulative times.
Record separately imports/setup/pins, profiled65-call work, report export/readback, and complete external Python lifetime; all remain within the same owned120 budget.
On failure preserve the exact failing ordinal and remaining unexecuted denominator, raw profile if available, source entry/exit evidence and failure receipt; no automatic repeat.
next_diagnostic_only.interpretation: cProfile timing is diagnostic overhead, not a speed comparison or product deadline measurement. Repeated source calls may warm filesystem/inspect caches. Attribution cannot be divided into this run170.49s to claim a controlled optimization gain.

possible_followup_only_after_attribution.static_scope: The full once-owned batch may retain a source-derived action-consumption/control-flow proof only after a separately reviewed new implementation and equivalence gate.
required_identity_boundary: Bind PID, unique active batch identity and exact function/method/MRO map; revoke on normal completion and all exceptions, reject reuse or concurrent use.

Bind code, defaults, keyword defaults, closure cells, complete defining-global dependencies and relevant immutable configuration. Object identity alone is insufficient for mutable dictionaries/defaults/closure values.
Audit every transitive dependency used by the static source proof. Any dependency that cannot be safely frozen or checked remains freshly checked; fail closed on unknown mutation.

Keep exact loaded identity checks at every original fork/resume boundary, and explicit source/archive pins at entry/exit. Do not claim these observations establish absence of arbitrary transient changes.

Never cache current supplied contexts, _cut outcomes, view/ACK/age/deadline/owner checks, or successful action guards. Retain16 fullinitial contexts,80 cuts,32 graphclones and all32 candidate outputs unless a later independent experiment proves a separate change.
future_negative_tests: changed current state after static admission
unknown cut and post-save terminal failure retained

limits: The96 conformance result certifies only the declared output comparison; no hidden-state/native authority or online protection.
The100ms complete-request target is unchanged and not met or certified here.
No runtime source, accepted API, candidate budget, physical rule or proof frequency has been changed by this design.
